note: point-in-time ledger read from data/metaculus/*.jsonl; resolutions from the public Metaculus API; prize is owner-reported only

house_prior.definition: mean(Brier submitted with house prior − Brier of the no-prior shadow) on resolved binary AI questions; ≤0 means the prior did not hurt

reveals.definition: exact sealed plaintext of every ledger line whose question has closed; check with tools/fleet/verify_commitments.py

money.definition: prize is entered by the owner from the Metaculus payout; never inferred from rank
